articles.title: OpenAI bugging case: Saudi consulate offers to pay bail for suspect
articles.description: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan is accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at OpenAI headquarters in San Francisco.

articles.title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
articles.description: Mesh will connect crypto and stablecoin wallets to Visa’s global payment network, allowing users to spend digital assets without a separate card.

articles.title: Mastercard Brings Its Fraud-Fighting Tools to Stablecoin Payments
articles.description: Unveiled at Money20/20, the API-based tool combines payment and blockchain intelligence to flag fraud, scams and sanctions exposure before funds move on-chain.

articles.title: Crushed tech stocks bounce — plus, new doctor survey keeps us positive on Lilly
articles.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

articles.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
articles.description: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.

articles.title: Why Some of America’s Biggest Companies Are Objecting to Tokenized Shares
articles.description: Nine companies, including Verizon, Broadcom and UnitedHealth, have objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue.

articles.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why
articles.description: The history of technological progress suggests that as AI spreads, the employment impact will hit women more than men.

articles.title: US Orders Civilian Agencies to Rip DeepSeek Out of Government Systems
articles.description: The Department of Homeland Security told civilian agencies to remove China's DeepSeek and any service built on it, and banned buying more, citing the risk of sensitive data reaching Beijing.

articles.title: JPMorgan's JPM Coin Arrives on Ethereum, Putting Bank Dollars on a Public Blockchain
articles.description: JPMorgan is rolling out JPM Coin on Ethereum for institutional clients, a token backed by dollars in its accounts that settles in seconds, any day of the week.

articles.title: Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop
articles.description: Apple sent invitations for an event next week, calling it "Pro and tell."

articles.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
articles.description: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.

articles.title: SEC Announces Roundtable on Machine-Understandable Data in the Age of Super Intelligence

articles.title: Saudi Arabia postpones big investor conference to 2027 as Iran-backed Houthis escalate attacks on kingdom
articles.description: Iran-backed Houthi militants have launched repeated volleys of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia since a deadly airport attack earlier this month.

articles.title: Elon Musk says he'll give a SpaceX share to every child in America next year
articles.description: The SpaceX boss said Monday that he'll give one of his company shares to every child in the U.S. next year. He didn't say how the share giveaway would happen.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
articles.description: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

articles.title: Abandoned Bitcoin? Wallet Targeted by Noah Doe Lawsuit Moves $33 Million
articles.description: A Bitcoin address dormant since 2013 moved 411.45 BTC worth about $33.4 million, according to Galaxy Research, and it’s among the wallets named in the “Noah Doe” lawsuit.

articles.title: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
articles.description: On Kalshi, Anthropic is seen as the last major IPO in 2026 after OpenAI delayed its public market debut. Others have postponed too.

articles.title: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
articles.description: The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.

articles.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
articles.description: The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.

articles.title: Cornell sexual assault case has some prospective students rethinking plans, consultants say
articles.description: Some prospective Cornell University students are rethinking applications amid the Jane Doe sexual assault lawsuit, college admissions consultants say.
